handoff.salientSummary: Implemented the guest-message and waitlist/notify-me backend: generalized org alarm, reservations tick (route, fan-out, interval, jobs-cron hook), EN/AR email and US-only SMS delivery with backoff and kill switches, dev email capture, manager-alert outbox and App receiver, resend/rotate, message-settings routes, erasure notice, and waitlist/notify-me services and routes. Carried-over gaps (a) and (b) are tested. Live curl checks passed on 3007; the full tenant-api suite passes except two staff tests that fail because of the clock (see issues).
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Schema + migration 0017; lib/org-alarm.ts multiplexing staffing and reservations modules (staff-alarm.ts adapter, staff-alarm.test.ts unchanged and green); rsv-tick-service (expire_holds, expire_requests with request_declined, auto_no_show only when configured and never charging, waitlist_offers, notify_me_match, deliver_messages, deliver_outbox, purge, follow-up computation), POST /api/reservations/tick, tick fan-out in workers/index.ts, reservations alarm module in the tenant-org Durable Object, Node interval timer, jobs-cron hourly 'Tenant reservations tick'. Messages: reservations-email (12 kinds EN/AR escaped HTML with emailTheme, rtl, manage/calendar links, per-kind custom note), reservations-sms (US only), queue with dedupe/schedule_version/upsert reconcile, delivery with 1/5/30 min backoff, send-time recheck, quiet hours, kill switches RESERVATIONS_EMAIL_ENABLED/SMS_ENABLED, master flag/waitlist flag gating, bulk-failure alert. Dev email capture (.dev-mail/{us,ksa}, App /mock-email/*, production-stripped). Manager alert outbox -> App POST /resources/reservations/notify (ids and counts only; location name resolved from i18n map). Operator POST /book/reservations/:id/resend with rotate, GET/PUT /setup/message-texts and preview, erasure sends cancellation_restaurant before clearing contact. Waitlist/notify-me: settings routes, operator /book/waitlist/*, public /reservations/waitlist/* and /notify-me, matching (3 FIFO, 15 min batching, 120 min suppression). Gaps: public slots carry areaId/areaLabel and config lists areas; day feed and detail return recorded client.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: No App routes/resources+/jobs.reservations-tick.ts was added: jobs-cron calls tenant nodes directly like the staff tick, so an App route would be dead code. Kill-switch behavior is covered by unit tests only, not re-verified live (needs a node restart with the env var). seed:reservations was not extended with message/waitlist demo data. Docs beyond scheduled-jobs.md and root AGENTS.md are left to docs-worker. notify_available messages carry no specific slot time; on-my-way raises no manager alert.

discoveredIssues.description: staff.adversarial.test.ts and staff.scope-limit.test.ts assert the response does not contain '2222' and fail whenever the epoch-ms timestamps contain that substring (current time 1792222xxx). Pre-existing and unrelated, but they will fail for validators during that window.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Use a needle that cannot appear in timestamps (for example 22220001) in those tests.

discoveredIssues.description: Operator-created bookings never carry smsOptIn (route has no field), so they get email only; SMS happens only for public bookings with smsOptIn.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Accept guest consent explicitly in the operator create body if product wants SMS for host bookings.

discoveredIssues.description: When the App context lookup is unavailable, due messages are held 10 minutes (HOLD_MS), so a validator who ticks while App is down sees flags_unknown and delayed delivery.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Start the App on 3001 before running tick-based checks.

discoveredIssues.description: Availability ETag does not include feature flags, so a flag change may not show through a cached 304.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Fold the waitlist/online flags into the availability ETag.

discoveredIssues.description: Existing mission services were started by earlier sessions with the old npm scripts (no DEV_EMAIL_CAPTURE_DIR) and a stale duplicate KSA tsx watcher; I restarted the nodes then stopped App, 3007 and 3009 at the end. Validators must start tenant-api-us/ksa from the current scripts to get capture.
